placements.text: Send the uncut clip with the photograph. Let the newsroom check the timestamp themselves.
Original saved here. Backup sent. They cannot erase it by taking down one post.
The headline says payment. It does not say we solved the shortage.
Exclusive tonight: leaked footage shows Chairman Barkington Orders making an undisclosed cash payment to a senior WOOF7 journalist.
The purpose of the payment has not been independently established. We have requested a response from both parties.
We got the payment. Not the reason.
Fine. A small victory. Can small victories buy dinner?
